title: Rollback concierge and customer-lift protocol for mixed-hosting model regressions
creator: Maya Singh
description: Create an operational runbook and automation glue (scripts, small HTTP endpoints) to act as a "rollback concierge" when model rollouts cause regressions across Redwood Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. The concierge coordinates rapid tenant-aware mitigation, cross-environment rollback, KV-cache reconciliation, and customer communications. This ticket covers runbook drafting, lightweight orchestration helpers, dashboards to monitor progress, and handoff templates for SE/CS teams.
background: We continue to see intermittent canary regressions where a model variant performs acceptably in synthetic tests but causes production downstream quality or latency regressions for a subset of tenants. Existing playbooks are scattered; operators spend too long mapping tenant slices across Hosted/Dedicated/Private lanes and reconciling KV cache or prefix cache state before a safe rollback. This increases customer MTTR and manual coordination costs.
reproduction_steps: 1) Model vX deployed to canary slices in Hosted region-us-west and to a Dedicated pool for a handful of enterprise tenants
2) Synthetic E2E test suite passes, but production saw SLA regressions (increased p99 latency) and scoring regressions for a tenant slice
3) Customer SE files urgent escalation; surface-level metrics appear normal until KV cache staleness is cleared and then errors spike
4) Operators perform ad-hoc rollbacks without a coordinated KV reconciliation leading to flipped traffic and stale responses for several minutes
immediate_mitigation: - Activate rollback concierge oncall rota (see links) and notify CS/SE channels
- Pause canary traffic and mark the variant as quarantined in model catalog
- For Dedicated tenants, apply tenant-level feature gate to pin to previous model version
- For Private deployments, trigger the private-control-plane rollback playbook and coordinate with customer on-airgap steps
- Begin KV prefix reconciliation: snapshot keys for affected slices, drain new writes to the variant, and warm previous model's cache before reroute
rollback_procedure: 1) Decide rollback scope: global rollout vs tenant-slice vs pool-level. Use decision matrix in 'rollback-concierge-decision-matrix' (link below)
2) If tenant-slice only: update routing layer to point slice to previous variant and enable warmup write path to rehydrate KV cache for previous model
3) If Dedicated pool: adjust autoscaler tagging and shift pool assignment, then perform KV cache drain on affected nodes and restart serving processes with prior model artifact

4) If Hosted wide: initiate staged rollback (region-by-region) with automated health gates (latency, error-rate, quality safeguards), do not proceed to next region until quality signals recover for 15 minutes
5) After rollback, run regression check suite against customer prompt set and confirm customer with sample validation before closing communications
post-mortem_notes: Collect exact model artifact SHA, rollout DAG, affected slices, and KV keysets. Include comparison diff of generation stats (perplexity, rerank delta) and latency histograms. Record timeline of communications to customers and internal broadcast times. Action items: instrument model rollout with tenant-aware preflight checks, small canary windows with automatic micro-rollbacks, and a KV cache-locked state that prevents dual-writes during rollbacks.
stakeholders: Diego Ramos (Dedicated infra) - Dedicated rollback ops
Anika Patel (Private deployments) - customer / on-prem liaison
acceptance_criteria: 1) Runbook covers Hosted, Dedicated, and Private paths with clear decision matrix
2) Two small automation helpers committed: (a) tenant-pin API to lock routing to previous variant, (b) kvcache-reconcile script that saves/restore prefix snapshot
3) Oncall playbook includes customer communication templates and SLAs for first response (15min) and rollback ETA (45min)
4) Dashboard panel added that shows per-slice rollback progress (percent traffic rerouted, KV reconciliation status, last validation sample)
5) Dry-run completed during maintenance window with EngOps and Support and documented notes
